description: This bar chart compares the performance scores of three language models—RedWhale (our), EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)—across six evaluation categories: PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG. The horizontal axis lists these six categories in left-to-right order, while the vertical axis represents performance scores, scaled linearly from 0 to 1.00, with tick marks at intervals of 0.20, and each bar’s height corresponds to its score, explicitly labeled above each bar. For the PT-EVAL category, the scores are 0.42 for RedWhale (dark purple), 0.46 for EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 (light blue), and 0.42 for SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base) (light gray). In the KoBEST-BQ category, scores are 0.52 for RedWhale, 0.56 for EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and 1.00 for SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base). For KoBEST-CP, scores are 0.71 for RedWhale, 0.74 for EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and 1.00 for SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base). In KoBEST-HS, scores are 0.50 for RedWhale, 0.54 for EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and 1.00 for SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base). For KoBEST-SN, scores are 0.69 for RedWhale, 0.73 for EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and 1.00 for SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base). The AVG category shows scores of 0.57 for RedWhale, 0.61 for EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and 1.00 for SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base). Each group of three bars corresponds to one evaluation category, with the dark purple bar representing RedWhale (our), the light blue bar representing EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and the light gray bar representing SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base), as indicated by the legend. The bars are not sorted by height; they are presented in the order of the evaluation categories listed on the horizontal axis. The SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base) model consistently achieves a score of 1.00 across all five evaluation categories, while RedWhale (our) achieves its highest score of 0.71 in KoBEST-CP and its lowest score of 0.42 in PT-EVAL.
